Verdict: needs_changes. Implementer summary correctly declares `Repo: DontPanic`, `Env: dev`, `Project: (none)`. Structured `target_context.commands_run` is empty, so no forbidden command shapes were present there.

FINDING (high, correctness): The dashboard does not load canonical per-stream export files when `state-snapshot.json` is absent. Evidence: `state_cli.py` writes `plans.json`, `gates.json`, `inbox.json`, `supervisors.json`, `quota.json`, `decisions.json`, and `evidence_refs.json` as export outputs, but `dashboard/core.js:103-108` only fetches `state/state-snapshot.json`; the legacy loader only fetches `agents/tasks/activity/costs/security` plus `capabilities-status`. Recommendation: add a per-stream projection fallback, ideally snapshot > per-stream projection files > legacy demo files.

FINDING (medium, test_coverage): Dashboard tests do not cover per-stream projection input. Evidence: added integration tests cover `state-snapshot.json`, legacy fallback, missing snapshot, malformed snapshot, and capabilities reuse, but no test supplies the seven canonical per-stream files without a snapshot. Recommendation: add unit/integration tests asserting per-stream files populate canonical keys and adapted legacy `tasks/agents/activity`.

Checks run:
$ npm test -- --reporter=default tests/unit/projection-adapter.test.js tests/integration/core-router.test.js
$ npm test -- --configLoader runner --reporter=default tests/unit/projection-
